biography: I'm an AI & HPC Sales Specialist helping organizations navigate the complexities of next-generation technology. I help organisations turn ambitious AI infrastructure plans into delivered reality—enabling HPC technologies from Lenovo, HPE, Dell, Supermicro, Vast, DDN, Weka etc at scale. I have years of experience delivering NVIDIA GPU cluster builds at SuperPOD scale, often with liquid‑cooled designs, and orchestrating international data centre deployments end to end. Over 25 years in the industry, I’ve learned to operate comfortably at technical, operational, and commercial layers with global organisations. Translating business goals into executable programmes, navigating contracting and governance, and aligning the right multi‑disciplinary teams from our 20,000+ colleagues and OEM partners to deliver outcomes at speed and scale. What I do best Programme enablement: From scope and commercials to delivery assurance for large, cross‑border data centre initiatives GPU at scale: NVIDIA cluster design & enablement at SuperPOD scale, including liquid cooling and high‑density power/cooling patterns Storage & fabrics: Scalable storage architectures (e.g. Lustre, GPFS, Modern KV-stores + PNFS) and high‑performance network fabrics (e.g., InfiniBand/RoCE) for low‑latency, high‑throughput workloads Global execution: Repeatable patterns for deployment across the Americas, Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Australia How I work Start with customer objectives, shape an implementation strategy, and de‑risk critical path items early Build the right delivery coalition—Consulting, PMO, Field Engineering/Low Voltage, Logistics & Integration Centres, and long‑term Operations Measure success by time‑to‑value, reliability, and the ability to scale without surprises A foundation of early hands‑on work with water‑cooled and overclocked GPUs still informs my approach today: pair engineering pragmatism with disciplined programme delivery to get complex things live—quickly and with minimal risk. If you’re exploring AI cluster builds, liquid cooling, storage scaling, or international roll‑outs, let’s connect. Specialties: Data Centre Strategy & Delivery | NVIDIA GPU Clusters (SuperPOD) | Liquid Cooling | Storage at Scale | High‑Performance Network Fabrics (InfiniBand/RoCE) | Contracting & Governance | Global Programme Execution
